[b]Main features[/b][/size][/color]

[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=4]She will have a special reaction to some gift items! Only 1 now, but will add more soon. Maybe even change her available gift list completely.
Because for now there's no way to learn which items are special, here's the list of items to which she will have a special reaction (it is a spoiler, ofc):[/size][/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=4]Install SMAPI. 
Download Content Patcher and this mod.
Unpack them in Mods folder in your game directory.
Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI launcher.
You're amazing![/size][/color]
